channels.status: live — knowledge 'why?' clips (Shorts) + long-form compilations. Name is PCSEV (handle @PCSEV), set by K in Studio 2026-11-17 and measured live from 3 sources (RSS, channel page, oEmbed); the main title is not API-settable, so the repo follows it. The pre-2026-11-16 genre was family stories ('เรื่องเล่าอบอุ่นใจ'/'เรื่องเล่าการ์ตูน'). scripts/set_channel_name.py writes the name (via localizations) + description/keywords; the daily rail channel-branding.yml keeps it in sync.
